description: Bookstore product page (books.toscrape template) carrying a JSON-LD Product with offer, availability and aggregateRating, plus a 'recently viewed' strip of four other books.

schema.title: string — book title
schema.currency: string — ISO 4217 currency code of the price
schema.availability: string — availability line exactly as displayed, e.g. 'In stock (3 available)'
schema.upc: string — UPC from the product information table

notes: Structured data covers title/price/currency/rating; availability text and UPC come from the page (JSON-LD availability is the schema.org URL, not the displayed line). Currency GBP is shown only as the £ symbol. Rating 4 is the class 'star-rating Four' and JSON-LD ratingValue; it is not printed as a number. The 'Products you recently viewed' cards (prices £19.63, £56.50, £16.64, £44.10) must not leak into the single-item output.
